title: Velvet santa bag
text: Velvet santa bag. So... the bag is a big stretchy... polyestery... which is actually good in my opinion. It is a little "velvet like" on the outside... It's big.  The measurements given are fairly accurate - it would hold a lot of small gifts or one pretty good sized one.  I THINK you could wash it on delicate...?  I use it for holding about 20lbs of individually wrapped candy for our golf cart parade.  Works great for my use!

product_metadata.title: Velvet Santa's Gift Sack with Cord Drawstring
features: OVERSIZED GIFT SACK: This 27"W x 31"H Oversized Gift Sack is roomy enough to hold numerous smaller gifts or one larger gift for Christmas fun! Kids will be delighted to see their presents in Santa's sack on Christmas morning.
FESTIVE COLORS AND MATERIALS: Made of soft red velvet with a white fur trim and pom-pom-capped drawstring cord, this Christmas gift sack matches Santa's traditional suit.
PERFECT FOR PARTIES: Eyes will light up when you show up to holiday parties bearing gifts in this Santa-like sack! Or, use it to tote Christmas treats to teachers or co-workers.

DECORATIVE ACCENT: Not only useful for holding gifts, this festive red and white sack also makes a perfect addition to your holiday decor when filled with wrapped gifts, or to store favorite Christmas books and toys for the kids to enjoy.
AGE GRADE AND PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS: For family use, not for use as a toy.
description: Let’s hope Santa keeps chimney soot off this fur-trimmed gift sack! The roomy, red velvet Oversized Christmas Toy and Gift Sack with pom-pom-capped drawstring cord is the perfect answer for Christmas surprises under the tree, or holiday party gifts. At 27"W x 31"H it’s almost big enough for Santa to carry a little something for every little girl and boy. Fill it with a variety of small wrapped gifts, or hide a WOW Christmas gift inside this spacious bag. Use it to deliver gifts to family Christmas get-togethers or treats for children's teachers, or to transport presents to the Christmas tree. It can even be used as a festive addition to your Christmas decor!
